scope: Launcher proof closure and fail-stop behavior plus unconditional zero-call engine configuration bindings; no native inference or production evaluator answers.
prior_report_limit: Prior 45-probe/28-test artifact is retained unchanged and predates the unconditional backend/retrieval check and this launcher proof/fail-stop patch. Those 45 probes were not rerun against these exact newer hashes.
verified_behavior: All six proof values have absolute path, byte size and SHA-256; changed native log bytes fail check_pin.
Execution proof journal includes terminal server-stopped event; prediction seal written after owned-process termination and journal close.
Missing preparation journal prevents prediction seal creation; actual preparation journal location is prepare/journal.jsonl.
Failed/interrupted arm status retains arm verification/result/report records, records arm_terminal_failure, raises and dispatches no later arm.
Failure keeps execution reservation and produces no prediction seal; calling execute again cannot repeat work.
Budget-exhausted is an accepted planned status and subsequent arms continue.
Seal helper refuses failed executions or a server not marked stopped.
limitations: Subprocess, socket, HTTP health and arm execution were mocked in launcher flow tests; no native ownership or actual inference success is established.
The evaluator tests and engine synthetic-opener tests establish technical contracts only, not comparative scientific or clinical validity.
Root independently owns and may perform subsequent explicitly authorized preparation/execution.
